notes.title: Spooky Scary Hotfix
notes.notes:

[h1]The Spookiest and Scariest Hotfix[/h1]
Hey there ghouls, we're coming to you live with a quick hotfix! First off, thank you so much for all your feedback! And we've taken those words, and applied them to code, and now those words are applied in game!

Before we get to the patch notes, we've got the SPOOKIEST SCARIEST event!

( ⚆ _ ⚆ )

[h1]Life Of The Traveling Salaryman[/h1]
It's October! It's spooky, and it's scary, and it's filled with blood and cleavers! Follow the life of a traveling Salaryman as he encounters all the gruesome and deadly horrors this entire world has to offer!

In other words, send us screenshots, and we'll add them in to a short little story that you can follow on twitter up until Halloween.

notes.title: Small Patch & Super Cool Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33198949/2ff97961c9a5f093bf5b69e4426ccd8aff0ce996.png[/img]

[h1]こんにちは it's us again[/h1]
A Wild PATCH has appeared!
o FIGHT
o ITEM
o RUN
o READ

Hey folks! We're here to present to you a few fixes! And some nice optimization which some of you have been all jazzed about. But the most important thing we have going on is our BRAND NEW ROADMAP!

As a note, the price of the game will increase each time that we complete a Milestone. However, if you own the game you will not need to pay more, and all Milestone features are added to your game free of charge. We thank you folks so much for being with us while we're in Early Access and your feedback has been fantastic!

There are also a few things we got planned that will be like fun little surprises. You can ask us about it but I'll probably be really vague and then panic because I can't keep a secret to save my life.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33198949/976ab5f0ccb442a9187ab550ee56b74deafa7bff.png[/img]

If you've any questions, comments or suggestions, feel free to yell very loudly at me on our [url=https://discord.gg/brimstone]Discord![/url] Otherwise, on to the patch notes

[h1]Super Cool Patch 0.2.0.2[/h1]

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list][*]Death icon that shows player deaths on the minimap (global)
[/*][/list]
[h1]Balance[/h1]

[*]Added item briefcase at the center entrance - Special thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/metaria8664]メタリア for bringing this to our attention![/url]
[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog 0.1.8.1
notes.notes:
[img=https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ExcitableRashIrishwolfhound-size_restricted.gif][/img]
[h1]BANZAI ROYALE Changelog[/h1]

First off, thanks to all our players for all your love and support for the game! We really appreciate any and all feedback. We're still small but we're growing and we hope to reach out to more and more people over the next week and more!

(๑ˊ͈ ॢꇴ ˋ͈)〜♡॰ॱ     ⸌̷̻( ᷇ॢ〰ॢ ᷆◍)⸌̷̻♡⃛

Now for some important notes!

[h1]Changes: [/h1]
Removed ticking SFX from Banzai Bomb
Changed default ping kick limit from 100ms to 150ms
Server will now send full disconnect reason in chat (for example if player is kicked for too high ping)
Moved Russia closer to EU and tweaked connection quality approximation

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
Fixed Fog of War not rendering correctly when spectating multiple players
Fixed spot in the arcade where players could get stuck
Fixed spot in the construction zone where players could get stuck
Fixed issue where players could dodge roll through unbroken glass in the diner
All players will now show up on minimap if free spectate mode is active

[h1]Added:[/h1]
Added support for most Japanese characters in UI
(Looking at you Japan! (((*°▽°*)八(*°▽°*)))♪ )
Added support for Cyrillic characters in UI
Added option to change texture resolution for systems will less VRAM

That's right! For all you folk participating in the tournaments over in Japan you can now type in Japanese characters! Most of them!


That's about it everyone! Just go into steam and verify the integrity of your files!
Steamをオープンして、ファイルの整合性を検証してください。

[h1]ヽ(＾▽＾)ﾉ┌┛Σ≡≡＝＝(*ﾟ□ﾟ:;’:┃[/h1]
